The Club

Designed as one experience

Clubist brings movement, hospitality and community together with a shared design language. The architecture, materiality, lighting and atmosphere of each space have been considered alongside the programming within it. A place designed not simply to be visited, but returned to.

I

The arrival

The club begins before the first class. Valet takes the car at the door, with the first hour and a half complimentary with every class. Inside, a single lit line draws the corridor past the retail gallery to the tree at its centre, and the three studios open from there.

The corridor  /  The tree

II

Designed with purpose

Design is integral to Clubist. Not as decoration, but as part of how the space is experienced: materiality, light, sound, art and proportion, considered in every room and carried through the smallest details.

III

Three studios, one standard

The Mind & Body Room, a state of the art infrared studio held at 32°C. The Megaformer Room, dedicated to the Lagree method on twelve Lagree Megaformers. The Dark Room, strength and conditioning under light and sound of its own.

The Mind & Body Room The Megaformer Room The Dark Room

Explore The Studios →

IV

The reset

Time after class is part of the hour. The changing rooms carry the same standard as the studios: rainfall showers, warm towels, Dyson styling, considered amenities and space to get ready without rushing.

V

Beyond the class

thirtyfour is part of the Clubist wellness ecosystem: a space for breakfast, coffee, lunch, meetings and time between classes, designed to sit naturally within the rhythm of the club.

ValetAt the door. The first 90 minutes complimentary with every class.
TowelsProvided for every class, with showers and changing rooms open to all clients.
RetailA considered edit of Clubist pieces and objects in the corridor gallery.
thirtyfourOpen through the day, from post-class breakfast to late afternoon.

Experience it

Three classes, across the club

Discovery is the introduction: three classes across The Mind & Body Room, The Megaformer Room and The Dark Room, before deciding how Clubist fits into your routine.
